_comment: Live market data for the Forward OS / Forward Motion Freight portal. Feeds the dashboard Market Pulse card and the Rate Calculator's suggested-rate button. SCHEMA MUST MATCH the portal reader's BUILTIN_MARKET shape in app/src/App.jsx (mergeMarketData): asOf, blurb, dieselPerGal, spotAllIn, trend(up|down|flat), modality[{type,rpm,yoy}], lanes[{lane,rpm}], commodityRates{}. Missing/malformed fields fall back to builtin per-field. Maintained by Dex (market desk agent) — see _sourcing for what's live vs carried-forward. Deploys to forwardmotionfreight.com/market.json via GitHub Pages.
blurb: Market's still supply-constrained and rates favor carriers — don't take the first offer, especially on reefer and flatbed. That said, this read hasn't been re-verified this week (see _sourcing), so treat it as last quarter's number, not this morning's.

_sourcing.status: carried-forward — nothing below is fresh. See refreshBlockers.
_sourcing.spotAllIn: carried-forward from the app's Q2 2026 snapshot. Not verified this cycle.
_sourcing.dieselPerGal: carried-forward. WebSearch surfaced a specific-looking $4.668/gal (week ending 2026-06-22) but it could not be checked against the primary EIA table (WebFetch blocked), so it was NOT used.
_sourcing.modality: carried-forward from the app's Q2 2026 modality ranges. Not verified this cycle.
_sourcing.commodityRates: carried-forward, unchanged. Not verified this cycle.
_sourcing.lanes: carried-forward, unchanged. Not verified this cycle.
_sourcing.blurb: carried-forward read, rewritten in founder voice — not a fresh market call.
_sourcing.directionalCaveatUnverified: Multiple trade-press headlines (titles only — Overdrive, FleetOwner, TheTrucker, DAT blog) consistently suggest dry van and reefer spot rates may be softening/stabilizing while flatbed keeps climbing, and diesel may be pulling back toward/under $5. Real signal, NOT verified against a primary source, deliberately excluded from the numbers — next refresh should chase this first.

refreshBlockers: WebFetch returned HTTP 403 for every external host tried this session (eia.gov ×3, dat.com/trendlines, fleetowner.com, truckingdive.com, thetrucker.com, macrotrends.net, en.wikipedia.org as control) — confirmed org egress-policy block via the agent proxy status, not site-specific. WebSearch returned internally inconsistent numbers for the same metric ($3.06 / $2.06 / $3.02 for the same week's dry-van spot), so nothing numeric was promoted to live this cycle.
